shadows.name: nav-solid

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for reveals and state transitions.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: [data-reveal] opacity 0 + translateY(16px) to rest, .7s ease-out, delay var(--d) x 70ms; IntersectionObserver adds .is-in once (threshold .12, rootMargin -8% bottom)

motion.name: hero-entrance
motion.value: [data-hero] opacity 0 + translateY(18px) to rest on html.is-ready, .9s ease-out, delay var(--h) x 90ms

motion.name: brush-draw
motion.value: stroke-dashoffset 1 to 0, 1.1s ease-io, .35s delay; on .is-in or html.is-ready

motion.name: silk-drift
motion.value: first light translate3d(0) to (10vw, 6vh), 30s ease-in-out alternate

motion.name: loader
motion.value: first session visit only; CSS keyframes (--k .7): strokes draw, leaves scale(.5) to 1, letters rise, script writes; JS holds min 1.5s, max 2.2s, then .is-out lifts translateY(-100%) .9s cubic-bezier(.76,0,.24,1); hero entrance 350ms later; CSS failsafe 4s

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animations off, transitions .01ms, no loader, reveal and hero blocks visible, brush drawn

silk.lightShape: 80vmax circles, radial-gradient(closest-side, color, transparent); no blur

narrative.overview:
Skin is the subject and silk is only the lining. The first thing to win is clarity: within seconds a visitor should know what this is, where it is, what it costs and how to book. The hero is a calm split on a blush ground. The copy is on the left: a hand signature, a plain-language headline with one brushed word, a short lede, two buttons and three facts. On the right, the photograph sits in a rounded card with a pearl price chip. Below the hero, the page is a stack of rounded panels, each rising over the last, in a fixed rhythm of solid grounds. Silk appears only behind packages, contact and the menu drawer. It is static CSS gradients with one slow drift.

The type voice is a soft editorial. Instrument Serif runs large with italic words carrying the colour. Corinthia signs single words, and Jost reads cleanly and holds the small tracked labels. The hand-drawn gold brush survives as the single decorative gesture. Prices are always visible as plain numbers. Treatments read as rows, with photo, description, price and a booking button in a single line of sight. Packages are cacao tickets with punched notches, bronze price pills and the 5x installment written out.

Motion is calm and never tied to scroll position. Each block fades up once as it arrives, and the hero enters once after the loader. Scrolling is native.
keyCharacteristics: Light split hero: copy left, photo card right, price visible in the first viewport.
Rounded panels that overlap the previous one, in a fixed light/dark rhythm.
CSS silk (rose or dark) only on packages, contact and the drawer.
Instrument Serif with coloured italics, Corinthia signatures, Jost body and labels.
One reveal per block (opacity plus a 16px rise, once). No scroll-linked animation, no libraries.

rules.name: The Ground Picks the Italic Rule
rules.body: Italic heading words take bronze on blush and pearl, gold on cacau and espresso, rose on dark silk and pearl on rose silk. Never use the same italic colour on every ground.

rules.name: The Panel Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Below the blush hero the panels alternate in this order: cacau why, pearl treatments, rose-silk packages, espresso how-it-works, blush results, pearl about, cacau voices, blush FAQ, dark-silk contact. Two adjacent panels never share a ground.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow and hairline is a tint of espresso, mocha, nude or gold. Pure black appears only in the before/after divider glow and the pill's under-shadow.

rules.name: The Signature Rule
rules.body: Corinthia sets one word or a short phrase as a hand signature. It never sets a sentence of copy.

rules.name: The Plain Headline Rule
rules.body: The hero h1 says what the service is and where it is offered. Poetry belongs in the lede and the quote, never in place of the service name.

rules.name: The Rising Sheet Rule
rules.body: Depth between sections comes from rounded panels overlapping, never from drop shadows on the panels themselves.

rules.name: The Silk Is Lining Rule
rules.body: Silk is a material behind content, never a fill for cards or text boxes. It appears only as `.silk--rose` (packages) or `.silk--dark` (contact, drawer). It is built from a linear base, four large `closest-side` radial lights, one of which drifts on a 30s transform loop, and a static diagonal sheen. No blur filters.

dos: Do state the service, place, starting price and booking path in the first viewport.
Do build new sections as panels: top corners rounded with `--panel-r`, a negative top margin of the same size, and a ground that keeps the light/dark rhythm.
Do colour italic heading words by their ground: bronze on light, gold on cacau and espresso, rose on dark silk, pearl on rose silk.
Do present services as rows with photo, body, price and an Agendar button side by side.
Do write prices in the serif with lining figures, and spell out the 5x installment value beside package prices.
Do use `[data-reveal]` (with `--d` for siblings) as the only scroll motion, once per block.
Do keep interactive surfaces as full pills and containers at 24px.
Do draw new icons on the 24-unit grid with round caps and a 1.1 to 1.6 stroke, in bronze on light grounds and gold on dark ones.
Do ship every image with `srcset` and `sizes`.
Do gate hover effects to `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`.
donts: Don't introduce a cool or grey hue. The palette is brown, rose-bronze and nude only.
Don't set the hero text over a dark photograph. Keep the hero light and split.
Don't pin, scrub, or tie animation to scroll position, and don't add animation libraries or smooth-scroll hijacking.
Don't use blur filters or full-page overlays.
Don't put drop shadows on panels or use hard offset shadows anywhere.
Don't use more than one brush stroke per panel.
Don't fill before/after or testimonials with stock or invented content. Keep the marked placeholder until real material arrives.
Don't add small uppercase labels above section headlines. Headlines open panels on their own.
Don't hold visitors at the loader longer than 2.2s or show it again in the same session.
